mettle.feedback.marksmanship.double_nock: Double Nock · a free second arrow
mettle.feedback.marksmanship.huntsman: Huntsman · arrow back, extra meat and hide
mettle.feedback.marksmanship.steppe_draw: Steppe Draw · steady from the saddle
mettle.perk.marksmanship.arrowstorm.desc: Keep holding a fully drawn bow and it looses an arrow every half second at three-quarter power, until you let go or run dry.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.deadeye.descrip: Arrows that strike a mob’s head deal double damage and always crit, and a headshot kill gives the arrow back.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.double_nock.des: Every fifth shot looses a second arrow beside the first, for free.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.fletcher.descri: Arrow recipes make half again as many: 6 arrows instead of 4.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.hunters_mark.de: Mobs you hit are outlined for you alone for 6 seconds.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.huntsman.descri: An arrow that kills an animal always comes back, and the kill drops one extra meat and hide.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.leaping_shot.de: Arrows you loose in mid-air are always critical.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.long_shot.descr: +5%% damage for every 5 blocks beyond 15, up to +50%%.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.pinning_shot.de: Fully drawn hits slow the target by about half for 2 seconds.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.quick_nock.desc: Nock within a second of your last shot and the draw is 40%% faster.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.quiverwise.desc: Crossbows load 40%% faster, and one arrow in four you shoot is kept.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.retrieval.descr: Arrows that hit a mob drop back where it dies %s%% of the time.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.sixty_paces.des: Your arrows fly 20%% faster, so they drop less at range.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.sixty_paces.hin: Some shots are talked about for years.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.steady_breath.d: Shots you loose sneaking at full draw fly 30%% faster and perfectly straight.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.steppe_draw.des: Bows reach full power at three-quarter draw, and shots loosed from the saddle don’t spread.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.steppe_draw.hin: Taught by a city’s hunter, or found in The Steppe Bow.
mettle.perk.marksmanship.volley.descript: Release a fully drawn bow while sneaking to loose three arrows in a spread (uses three).
